blurb: Guests fly in a hot air balloon gondola over Frederick County, Maryland, enjoying views of the Appalachian mountains, downtown Frederick, and local wildlife. Flights occur either half an hour before sunrise or two hours before sunset when winds are calm. The experience includes opportunities to learn from the pilot or simply enjoy the ride.

quotes.text: What an amazing adventure! Family run and SO friendly from the start. Patrick, our pilot, was friendly, informative, and made the entire experience fantastic. Patrick was always smiling, happy to point out points of interest, and crack a "dad joke" to keep things lively I would definitely go back!

Had a great anniversary experience... Patrick and the crew were outstanding, made us feel welcome and comfortable in our first ballooning experience. Patrick was very knowledgeable and enjoyed teaching up about the history and craft of ballooning...

What a great adventure! Our takeoff and landing were flawless and the scenery from 2,000 feet up was spectacular. Patrick is not only very experienced, but he is also quick to share his knowledge and is able to put everyone at ease...
